credentialFile.label: GitHub credential file
credentialFile.help: Absolute path to the fine-grained personal access token for the reviewer account. Read once at gateway start; never re-read by any agent-invokable tool.

provisioningFile.label: Credential provisioning evidence file
provisioningFile.help: Absolute path to the trusted record written when the GitHub token was installed or rotated: login, repository coverage and permissions, bound to the installed credential.

assignmentsFile.label: Dispatch assignment file
assignmentsFile.help: Absolute path to the host-managed dispatch assignment store that binds each reviewer session to an immutable {repo, pr} assignment.

signingKeyFile.label: Flair signing key file
signingKeyFile.help: Absolute path to the reviewer's Flair signing key. Custody is separate from the GitHub credential; only the host-side audit path uses it.

approvalEvidenceFile.label: Approval evidence file
approvalEvidenceFile.help: Absolute path to the approval-evidence store that scripts/reviewer/run-review-jobs.mjs writes. A relative path is rejected.

approvalEvidenceKeyFile.label: Approval evidence key file
approvalEvidenceKeyFile.help: Absolute path to the HMAC-SHA256 key that authenticates approval-evidence records.

allowedRepositories.description: The host-configured repository set (owner/repo). A github_review call for any other repository is refused.

maxBodyBytes.description: The finite UTF-8 byte limit for a review body. REQUIRED: an absent or invalid limit is a configuration failure and disables posting.

reviewerIdentity.description: The reviewer agent identity the host signing key belongs to; the dispatch assignment's reviewer must match it.

pendingAuditFile.description: Where an audit record that failed after a confirmed GitHub post is retained for host-side retry. Required: posting is refused before any request when unset.

reconcileFile.description: The durable per-dispatch latch store (one host, local filesystem; every read-modify-write under its O_EXCL lock file). Before a review is posted the dispatch is claimed here: `reserved` plus the call's claim, held across the POST. It becomes `posted` (final) or `reconcile_required` (uncertain outcome). Only a GitHub response proving the POST created no review releases it; the host's `latch-admin reconcile` never releases — it latches `posted` when the recorded receipt id is listed, and otherwise a further review is a fresh dispatch. Required: posting is refused before any request when unset.

approvalEvidenceFile.description: Absolute path to the approval-evidence store that scripts/reviewer/run-review-jobs.mjs writes. APPROVE is refused unless it holds one authenticated, passing record for this dispatch and the configured CI job, and unless it and the key are outside every sandboxMountRoots path.

approvalEvidenceKeyFile.description: Absolute path to the HMAC-SHA256 key that authenticates approval-evidence records.

approvalCiWorkflow.description: The workflow file an approval-evidence record must name.

approvalCiJob.description: The CI job an approval-evidence record must name.

sandboxMountRoots.description: Every host path a review sandbox mounts, each absolute. Required for APPROVE.

sandboxImageDigest.description: The deployed reviewer sandbox image digest, recorded in every audit record once the reviewer image (section A) supplies it.

provisioningMaxAgeDays.description: Provisioning evidence older than this many days is stale and disables posting. Default 90.
